title: Move through notes on the page: a note cursor, thread jumps and folding

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Design, proposed 2026-10-09: Page gets a cursor into the threaded notes, with the body as item 0. j/k move the cursor and the pane scrolls to keep the chosen box in view; the chosen box has a bright border and the rest are dim, like panes. Space folds the replies under the chosen note, the bottom border then says how many. u jumps to the note this one answers, [ and ] to the previous and next sibling, g/G to the ends, Ctrl-d/Ctrl-u scroll half a page without moving the cursor. posts() returns each note's line range so the draw can place the cursor.
